asr.full_text: So the DOT chart is also under pressure. If we if we zoom out a little bit, we can actually see that better. But DOT is currently testing key levels. So what is important is to understand that there is a cluster of support around 220% to 230%. If that breaks, it opens the door to a test of the $1.75 level, maybe even a bit lower, $1.43, $1.11. Pressure is downward on this chart clearly. I'm still tracking two bearish scenarios. I do not expect all-time highs to form. This chart gave us a five-wave decline. So from an educational point of view, very important to understand if we have a five wave decline on a macro chart or an altcoin chart, it's typically not clearly bullish unless we can get some proper impulses. Now this year was really questionable, it could have turned into something, but the pullback here was so deep that it just didn't make sense to really follow a bullish pathway anymore um that became clear more than a year ago so it's possible that um yeah we we saw that wave one to the downside yeah and then all of this is part of a wave two and we can still go lower resistance here would be between 524 and 10.03 um in case we get a bounce from here it could take us into that resistance area but then i would monitor this resistance area closely for a reaction because the risk would be high that a third wave down starts from there or and that would be more directly bearish if it's the orange count we already topped in roman wave two here in March 24. Long time ago. And this is a wave 1 down, a wave 2 up. This is a third wave down, which has already reached minimum targets, the 138% extension at 230. And so from here we could get a fourth wave bounce, maybe even after another low. Any further downside from here would shift probabilities even more towards the orange scenario again then we could get a way for bounce and the fifth wave down and would unfold like that so pressure remains downward I don't even see any reaction here a reaction here wouldn't be surprising though but there's literally nothing there. So yeah, pressure appears downward, earliest indication. I'd say that a low of sorts has formed, yeah, probably, hold on, probably a break above the last swing high, which formed here at 280, 280. But as long as we are below 280, there isn't even an indication that, you know, even a local recovery is unfolding. So, pressure down for now.
